notes: The actual run start was not clock-sampled. The first UTC timestamp sampled during the run was 2026-11-20T09:41:54.609842+00:00, after the whole and half views. started_utc is null to avoid inventing a start time.

Only the assigned brief, preamble, page bundle, whole image, two supplied halves and the three recorded crops were read. No OCR, recognition, extraction, internet, other page or other reader was used.
Whole once; half_a once; half_b once; each crop once. No failed display or redisplay occurred. All bboxes use original whole-image coordinates; half_b begins at whole y=1009.

The page is a corrected typewritten draft with one diagonal cancellation across its main text. It continues an earlier sentence and has three main text blocks. It contains no diagram or displayed derivation; formulas are embedded in prose. The small marginal curve is reproduced graphically.

The first block claims finite locally free properties, a base-change property of an underlined Hom, and equivalence of torsor and extension categories under formal completion. These are source claims, not theorems independently verified here.
The second block claims functoriality of the extension G with a natural decoration and compatibility with base change by a morphism of complete traits.

Section 7.6.3 describes a noetherian adic generalization and calls algebraizability of the abelian formal scheme the essential question, asserting that the method of 7.2 applies when S is normal. No proof check was performed.

The words La question essentielle and the conditional assertion concerning normal S are written text. There is no visible question mark or explicit à vérifier reservation. Editorial doubt signs in this record are not source annotations.

Source spellings retained: systêmes twice; cphérents once; qutun; inserted sbhéma. The repeated par un around schéma abélien and the cancelled schéma before tore are retained without grammatical repair.

Mathematical context located the relevant formulas but supplied no missing sign or letter. In particular, the underlined oval is not replaced by H’s Z on the strength of a proposed group interpretation, and the uncorrected quotient numerator is not changed to V to regularize the formula.

The black margin stroke is reproduced literally because deciding whether it is V or a check would add an interpretation. Its origin and maker remain unassigned. This is an interpretation limit, not unresolved graphic geometry.

Handwritten text-page number 74 and archive number 82 are recorded. There is no title or date, letter heading, signature or total page count. Section 7.6.3 and references (7.6.1), 7.1, 7.2 are not page totals.

H’s introductory note and character-interpretation note are editorial and are not treated as ink or as missing source text. No discrepancy is counted for an absent extraction page macro or for equivalent archive-number notation.
No mathematical checks are claimed: checks is empty. Producing a transcription and comparing the witnesses were reading events, not proof verification.
